description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sprouting Thrinax, adding {C}{C}.
When Sprouting Thrinax dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three creature tokens.
